gaps.explanation: Nothing missing and nothing counted twice. Detail revenue 1,229,294 = statement 949,293 + 280,000 + 1. (a) 280,000: the Special Revenue Fund Types budget schedule (p14, printed p34) prints 'Proceeds of bond issuance' 280,000 among RECEIPTS, so detail has it as a revenue line (Special Revenue Funds, Proceeds of bond issuance 280,000). The governmental funds statement (p5, Road column) prints the same 280,000 as 'Proceeds from bond proceeds' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (JSON debt_proceeds 280,000), not in Total revenues 949,293 (p4). Same money, printed in a different section by each statement; the line stays as printed. (b) 1: General Fund budget schedule receipts before transfers 547,431 (p9-10: total 569,408 less transfers in 21,977) vs statement General column Total revenues 547,430 (p4): rounding in the report. Per fund: General 547,431 vs 547,430; Debt Service 86,320 vs 86,320 (p13 vs p4); Special Revenue (Road + CDA) 595,543 + bond proceeds 280,000 vs Road 124,557 + CDA 190,986 = 315,543 (p4); 595,543 - 280,000 = 315,543.

Detail holds the gross fund-column transfers out printed on p5 and on the budget schedules: General (91,000) (p12) and CDA (48,076) (p14 'Transfer out') = 139,076. The statement Total Governmental Funds column (p5) nets 119,913 of interfund transfers in its Reclassifications column (transfers in General 21,977 + Road 97,936 = 119,913), leaving transfers out (19,163) (JSON transfers_out 19,163; transfers_in null). 139,076 - 119,913 = 19,163. The gross transfers in 21,977 and 97,936 are also in detail. Nothing missing or duplicated.
